candidates.title: Choose Path Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the path selection screen using a stage layout with clear path choice cards and playful visual styling.
candidates.why: Drop-off at choose_path is 23.8% with a long mean duration of 514s, showing users get stuck choosing how to start.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Journey
choose_path.body: Select how you would like to create and adopt your virtual desktop pet.

guard.reason: Redesigns path selection screen layout while retaining path options.

candidates.score_note: Choose path drops 23.8% with high mean time, but past redesign test showed -1.4% lift and costs a full screen update.

candidates.title: Pet Trait Setup Screen
candidates.change: Add a new personality trait screen before home intro where users select key behaviors for their pet.
candidates.why: Overall finish rate is low (17.8%); giving users custom control over pet behavior right before finishing increases attachment and completion.

new_pet_traits.headline: Set Your Pet Personality
new_pet_traits.body: Choose traits for your companion to shape how it interacts on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adds a valid new pet trait selection screen inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has 35.2% drop-off, but adding a new_screen previously yielded -3.9% lift on finish.

candidates.title: Deferred Sign In After Adoption Prep
candidates.change: Move the sign_in screen after pet customization screens (pick_friend and upload_photos) right before adoption confirmation.
candidates.why: 27.1% drop off at sign_in early in the flow; deferring account creation allows users to build an emotional connection to their pet first.

guard.reason: Reorders sign-in step within onboarding without skipping required steps.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in drop-off is 27.1%, but reorder changes previously produced a -6.2% result on sign_in.

candidates.title: Pet Naming Sub Flow
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated naming screen within the adoption flow to let users formally name their pet.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 39.1% dropoff rate and median 89s / mean 1017s time; explicit naming steps build clear structure.

new_naming_flow.headline: Name Your Companion
new_naming_flow.body: Give your new pet a name to make official ownership documents.

guard.reason: Adds a valid pet naming sub-flow screen inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off (39.1%) and long duration; new_flow is the only change type with positive past results (+1.9%).

candidates.title: Account Restore Sign In Clarification
candidates.change: Clarify sign-in screen copy with instructions on how signing in restores existing pets and prevents account duplication.
candidates.why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, indicating confusion during sign-in.

sign_in.headline: Welcome Back to Desktop Pets
sign_in.body: Sign in with your registered account to restore your existing pets and progress.
sign_in.hint: Use the same email or method you used during your previous setup.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Generation Progress Timer and Status
candidates.change: Enable progress visualizer and estimated time indicator on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a high mean duration of 2336s and 18.7% dropoff because users lack feedback on loading status.

waiting.headline: Creating Your Desktop Pet
waiting.body: We are preparing your pet graphics and desktop behaviors. This will only take a moment.

guard.reason: Adds real progress and estimated time indicators to waiting screen during pet rendering.

candidates.score_note: Home wait time is 2336s with 18.7% drop-off; clear waiting status addresses user abandonment directly.

candidates.title: Desktop Notification Toggle on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Add a notification alert option so users get notified when pet setup finishes if they minimize the app.
candidates.why: Mean waiting duration is over 38 minutes (2336s), showing users minimize or leave the screen while waiting.

waiting.hint: Minimize the window anytime. We'll alert you when your pet is ready!

guard.reason: Adds notification toggle on waiting screen as allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme mean duration (2336s) at home step by allowing users to background the app safely.

candidates.title: Two-Column Adoption Certificate Layout
candidates.change: Update adoption certificate layout to two columns, showing pet preview alongside certificate terms.
candidates.why: Adoption stage loses 39.1% of users; a structured side-by-side layout makes summary review faster.
